# Jacob Chademwiri

> Tender, Project & Accounts Receivable Manager, Web Developer based in Centurion, Gauteng, South Africa.
> Specialised in tender acquisition, enterprise AR governance (SAP & Sage), operational project management, and high-performance web development (React, Next.js, Astro). Governed by ISO 9001, 14001, and 45001 quality and compliance standards.

## Core Capabilities & Positioning
- **Full-Time Employment Focus**: Tender Management, Project Management, and Accounts Receivable (AR) Management with deep ERP billing and financial reconciliation expertise (SAP ERP and Sage Accounting).
- **Freelance & Consulting Focus**: Full Tender Preparation Lifecycle (RFP/bid document analysis, compliance scheduling, CIDB/CSD validation, rate schedules, and winning bid compilation) and Custom Website Development (React, Next.js, Astro, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS).
- **ISO Standards in Practice**: Cross-cutting application of ISO 9001 (Quality), ISO 14001 (Environmental), and ISO 45001 (Health & Safety) Integrated Management Systems (IMS) across operational delivery, SHEQ governance, and digital execution.
